{{Quote|Fresh Sizhranian lettuce tossed with Hocekureem Sea salt croutons. Fit for a Falleen prince!|Dex's Diner on its Xizor salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Hocekureem Sea salt croutons''' were a type of [[crouton]]<ref name="Menu" /> that shared its name with the [[Hocekureem Sea/Legends|Hocekureem Sea]], a [[Salt/Legends|salt]] [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|48|Hocekureem Sea}}</ref> on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> The [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Menu" /> on [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the croutons with its [[Xizor salad]],<ref name="Menu" /> which shared its name with the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]].<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hocekureem Sea salt croutons was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
